text:
riley: Quick sync — launching an OSS hands-on codelab + companion webinar next Wed. Need: launch post, benchmark narrative for the blog, webinar page copy, and inbound lead routing (form -> CRM). Who can take launch post + PR? :raising_hand:
sam: I can own the launch post and PR. I’ll draft copy and a short benchmark section. Will open PR today. link: https://github.com/redwood/oss-codelab/pulls
anya: I’ll wire up inbound routing to HubSpot and add UTM mapping. Anything specific for lead scoring?@sam :thinking_face:
morgan: I can do webinar page copy + 2 headline variants for A/B. Suggest we highlight the latency vs cost bench we ran — simple chart + one-liner takeaway. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
riley: Awesome — thanks. Sam, please include a tiny benchmark narrative: workload (chat completions), models used (open model + quantized runner), median p95 latency and cost/unit. Keep it digestible for non-technical audience.
sam: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/oss-codelab/pull/42 — includes launch post + benchmarks section (summary + table). Will add plain-language blurb for the blog lead.
anya: Routing plan draft: map form -> HubSpot form 123, set utm_source=oss_codelab, utm_campaign=oss_launch_may, then trigger workflow that tags leads by role if they select "engineering" vs "product" on form. Patch in case statement: ```
if (form.role === "engineering") { tag = "eng-lead" }
else if (form.role === "product") { tag = "pm-lead" }
else { tag = "other" }
```
morgan: Headlines (short): 1) "Build a low-latency LLM refapp with Redwood — hands-on codelab" 2) "Ship a production-ready chat app: OSS codelab + benchmarking" — lean towards #1. Also adding CTA for the webinar: "Sign up to follow the build + see live benchmarks."
riley: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) Sam — include a 1-paragraph developer takeaway we can tweet (30-40 words). 2) Anya — please add tracking snippet to the webinar registration page and confirm test lead shows up in HubSpot before we publish.
sam: Will do both. Tweet blurb draft in PR comments.
anya: Will add tracking and post screenshots of test lead in this thread. Expect by EOD.
deploy-bot: Reminder — webinar page deploy scheduled: production at 2023-05-18T18:00Z unless blocked.
riley: Great progress — target to publish launch post + webhook deploy by Tue morning so marketing emails can go out. Final QA checklist in PR comments. :thumbsup:
